newsitem.title: THAILAND: Quality Houses says in 1.052 bln baht share issue.
newsitem.headline: Quality Houses says in 1.052 bln baht share issue.

text.p: Thai property firm Quality Houses Plc will raise 1.052 billion baht ($33.9 million) through a new rights issue, the company said on a statement on Monday.
The firm will offer a total of 105.2 million shares at 10 baht per share raising registered capital to 3.07 billion baht, the statement said.

Some 68.14 million shares would be issued through a rights issue at five old shares to two new shares for which the registration book will close on September 26. Subscription and payment is set for October 13-17, the company said.

An additional 31.03 million shares would be issued through a private placement and another 6.05 million would be offered to the company's directors and employees at 20 baht per share, the statement said.
Proceeds from the issue will be used to repay loans and for working capital, the firm said. ($1 = 31 baht)
